title: Fabulously Polished
description: A modpack that aims to make Minecraft feel and look better
body:
A completely client side modpack aiming to polish minecraft and to enhance your experience with many little mods
# Performance
The modpack is based on [Fabulously Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fabulously-optimized), check it out for more information on the performance side.
# Client sided
Fabulously Polished doesnt include content mods, that means it can be used on any server!(some servers may have rules against certain mods; just because you can, it isnt always allowed)
## help me out
I am in search of a better logo; if anyone of you could make one that would be awesome. The person would of course get credited, unfortunatly, thats all i can give you for the logo.
### Mod menu helper
  The mod [mod menu helper](https://github.com/Fabulously-Optimized/fabulously-optimized/tree/main/Resource%20Packs/Mod%20Menu%20Helper) resource pack gives further information on mods in the mod menu
